messages:
marta: morning shift, quick heads-up :wave: we just got a latency pager for hosted us-west-2 – p95 for /v1/generate jumped to ~900ms at 07:20 UTC. incident-bot: Pager fired (P2) — service: inference-hosted, symptom: high p95, region: us-west-2, triggered_at: 07:20 UTC.

aj: on it, will check autoscaling and recent deploys. primary now is marta, secondary is aj for the next hour (per handoff).

marta: thanks. quick impact note — user-facing timeouts for some streaming clients, a handful of 504s. Not a full outage but customer impact visible for low-latency routes.

samir: @marta @aj if you need immediate mitigation and want to reduce p95 fast, we can flip routing to the dedicated fallback pool (lower throughput, better tail latency). That buys time for a proper fix.

nora: adding runbook pointers: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/latency-and-fallbacks and https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-stalls — both have step-by-step checks.

aj: first quick checks:
- logs: `kubectl logs -n inference -l app=hosted-gateway --tail=200`
- health: `curl -sS https://hosted-usw2.redwood/health | jq .`
- recent deploys: `redwoodctl deploy list --region us-west-2 --since 1h`

marta: seeing a slow spike in cache misses on the prefix cache; kv-cache eviction rate is high. Suspect underprovisioned KV nodes during morning surge.

incident-bot: Escalation suggestion: follow 'kv-cache-throttle-recovery' play in runbook.

aj: mitigation plan: 1) scale kv-cache replicas +2, 2) enable prefix cache throttling, 3) route low-priority traffic to dedicated fallback. Doing step 1 now.

aj: running: `kubectl scale statefulset/kv-cache -n infra --replicas=5` (current 3 -> 5). ETA ~45s for pods ready.

marta: while that scales, I'm going to temporarily lower batch sizes for hosted route to reduce tail latency. Command: `redwoodctl config set-route --name /v1/generate --region us-west-2 --max-batch-size 8`

samir: volunteered to watch until pods ready and confirm cache hit rate improves.

nora: quick checklist reminders (from runbook):
- check KV eviction pressure: `curl -sS http://kv-metrics-usw2/metrics | grep kv_evictions`
- confirm model inference queue depth: `redwoodctl metrics query "inference.queue_depth{region=\"us-west-2\"}"`
- if p95 still >600ms after scaling, flip routing: `redwoodctl route set --policy fallback-lowlatency --region us-west-2` (manual approval required).

aj: kv-cache pods are up. I'm seeing cache hit rate climb from 62% -> 86% over last 90s. p95 dropped to ~420ms.

marta: nice. keep the batch_size change in place for now. I'll monitor 10min window and decide on rollback.

oncall-escalation-bot: Note: primary remains marta; secondary aj. Coverage gap 07:50-08:10 UTC (marta calendar blocked). Need a volunteer for that window.

samir: I can cover 07:50-08:10 UTC — will stay on pager.

marta: thanks @samir. Post-incident tasks:
- create a short incident note in #incidents (summary + customer impact)
- follow runbook steps to increase autoscaling thresholds for kv-cache during morning surge
- add a quick alert to detect KV eviction rate > 30/min earlier.

aj: adding quick followup commands for postmortem trace: `redwoodctl trace get --service hosted-gateway --since 10m` and `redwoodctl deployments history --region us-west-2 --last 3`.

marta: summary for handoff to night team:
- what happened: kv-cache eviction spike during morning surge -> cache misses -> increased p95 on hosted generate routes.
- immediate mitigations: scaled kv-cache (3->5), lowered batch size on /v1/generate, monitored until p95 < 500ms.
- runbooks used: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-stalls , https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/latency-and-fallbacks
- followups: tune autoscale, add eviction alert, consider capacity bump for morning windows.

nora: reminder: add the command snippets to the incident doc so on-call next time can run them quickly.

marta: last note — no customer-facing RCA yet, but Customer Success notified for affected tenants. If anything regresses, ping @aj and @samir immediately. :+1:

aj: closing loop — p95 stable ~380ms now, no further action unless it climbs. Leaving this thread for the log.

samir: thanks. I'll take the 07:50 slot and watch for 20 more minutes after.

marta: done, thanks team."
